_about: Script Edit and the rest of the Editor's reading, one way for the Python Editor and the viewer's: run by tests/test_script_cases.py (EditorSession.script_view, set_script_text, result_check; workflow.script_words, script_refs, leveled_roll; mwscript.flowchart, tes3conv.listing_for_bytecode_field; the Lua panel's charts) and viewer-shell/editcore/tests/cases.rs (editcore::mwscript, editcore::scripts). Each case is a load order (`plugins`, each with its masters and its records in the tes3conv schema), written to files for the compiler (its scripts as the compiler makes them), and operations: ["script", tag, id, text or null] (editScript), ["save_script", tag, id, text], ["result", response, text or null] (editResult), ["words"], ["refs", word], ["flowchart", tag, id, text or null], ["roll", tag, id, level] (editLeveledRoll), ["lua", path, text, kind, line or null] (editLuaChart, the chart given back), ["listing", bytecode field, source or null], ["insert", tag, id], ["duplicate", tag, id, new id], ["pending"]. The session's scripts carry their bytecode unpacked (base64 of its length and bytes), so a listing reads the same with or without a zstd backend. `expect` is what each gave and the journal after them. Generated from the Python side when a case is added, and read by hand.
